question: Should Signal setup standardize on local signal-cli or an operator-managed existing server, remove any OpenClaw-managed Docker path, and make channel apiMode the default with optional per-account overrides?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent, but it deliberately defines the supported Signal setup model and changes compatibility-sensitive routing and configuration semantics; repository evidence cannot determine that permanent product contract without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the two-transport contract
options.body: Accept the wizard and account-scoped routing model after exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof confirms existing native, container, and mixed-account setups remain usable.

options.title: Split setup from runtime semantics
options.body: Land the guided setup separately and defer per-account apiMode plus readiness/status changes to a narrower compatibility-reviewed follow-up.

options.title: Pause the setup direction
options.body: Keep the existing manual setup model until maintainers decide whether OpenClaw should support a different container or server-management workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve the two-transport contract
recommendation.body: Accept the wizard and account-scoped routing model after exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof confirms existing native, container, and mixed-account setups remain usable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to onboarding, channel setup, and repository-wide compatibility decisions.
